note: Fetch-health registry. Each scheduled fetch workflow records its last run via scripts/update_fetch_status.py so fetches remain observable (timely) and only commit when data changed (relevant). Update this file when adding/removing workflows.

fetch-13f.notes: 13F filings from SEC EDGAR; aggressive mid-Feb/May/Aug/Nov

fetch-adp.notes: ADP Private Employment; first Wednesday of month

fetch-bls.notes: BLS Jobs/CPI/PPI/JOLTS; excludes PPI (sourced via FRED PPIFIS)

fetch-earnings.notes: Earnings (yfinance) + SEC quarterly; ANT manual entry preserved

fetch-fred-monthly.notes: FRED monthly series incl. Case-Shiller, FHFA HPI, New Home Sales (replaces the three removed dedicated workflows)

fetch-fred-weekly.notes: FRED weekly series (Jobless Claims, Mortgage Rate, Petroleum Exports)

fetch-treasury.notes: Treasury Fiscal Data API (debt, MTS, interest, tariffs); hourly

fetch-usda.notes: USDA NASS commodity prices; monthly around 5th

fetch-world-cup.notes: World Cup scores; every 10 min during June-July tournament window

update-nfl-odds.notes: NFL odds refresh (daily + game-day + post-game); consolidated from update-nfl-odds / live / postgame
